verdict.rationale: Trello documents an app marketplace of Power-Ups. Its docs invite teams to link their favorite tools via plugins, find the apps they already use, and note that third-party developers submit Power-Ups to the marketplace through a review process. A community user mentions using a third-party plugin (NightReader), and another complains about add-on restrictions for solo users, which points to plan-based limits. missing for 10: evidence that the marketplace reaches the 'thousands' of tools the story names, independent corroboration of how broad the catalog is, and clarity on add-on limits by plan.
